_comment: Built-in sample for the SMART Exchange preboarding flow (src/pages/sx-preboarding/, sx-preboarding.js, TCDM-5263). Preboarding is sent with NO payment: a buyer (payer) invites a supplier to confirm its business, pick a preferred payment method and create an account. Copied once per tab into sessionStorage `sx-preboarding-sample`. Demo rules: identity answers made only of zeros (e.g. 0000) are wrong; `existingEmails` trigger the Create Account 'already exists' error.
